chef_intro: ^Did you really have to use explosives? You are ruining my kitchen with all that dust!
^I know why you are here. You want to go upstairs. But you can't. The main pipe is leaking toxic gas.
^I took the gas valve to protect my supplies. I have it right here.
^I will give it to you, but you must do something for me first. The Director's dinner is tonight, and the dining room is a mess.
chef_questions: ^Where are the items for the table?
^I will set the table for them.

c-0: ^The Director, the Professor, a loyal worker, and a test subject. They are strict about their table setup. If they get angry, we are both dead.
c-1: ^The Director always sits at the head of the table. He exclusively uses the silver knife.
^As for the test subject... you must seat him as far away from the Director as possible, or he will attack him across the table.
c-2: ^Scattered. Check the dark pantry next door. You might find the old incident reports there, too. You will need them. Figure out the rest yourself.
c-3: ^Go to the dining room. Put the four items in their correct places. Don't make a mistake.

chef_waiting: ^Are you deaf? The Director is almost here! Check the pantry for the missing items and place them on the table!
chef_done: ^You actually placed everything correctly. I am impressed.
^The valve is yours. I tossed it into that old grey metal cabinet over there. But to be honest... I have so much on my mind, I forgot which of the 12 drawers it's in.
^There is a document somewhere around here. Find it, find the right drawer, take the valve and let me cook in peace.
chef_leave_me: ^I gave you the valve. Let me cook in peace!
